reason: 该插件的主要功能是向 DSH 用户界面展示 OpenCode Go 套餐额度：在悬浮胶囊/面板中显示滚动、周、月窗口的用量与剩余额度及重置时间。证据表明其通过主进程提供 `/og-usage/api/usage` 接口、读取本地凭据并调用 opencode.ai 接口，再在前端进行可视化展示，因此属于外部服务使用监测与可视化工具。

summaries.zh: 该插件在 DSH 界面提供可拖拽的浮动胶囊和可展开面板，实时展示 OpenCode Go 在滚动、周和月三个维度的用量与剩余额度。
summaries.en: This plugin adds a draggable floating capsule and expandable panel in DSH that shows real-time OpenCode Go usage and remaining quota for rolling, weekly, and monthly windows.

reasons.code: Host route reads local `opencode-go` credential from `~/.local/share/opencode/auth.json` and uses it for API requests.
Plugin sends usage queries to external endpoint `https://opencode.ai/zen/go/v1/usage` for rolling, weekly, and monthly quota data.
Client UI renders a draggable, collapsible floating capsule/panel in overlay and refreshes quota data on a 60-second interval.
